catalog.scope: Frozen gold New York intraday 15-minute EMA10/EMA30 plus RSI55/45 cross benchmark only
catalog.entry_distance_definition: Absolute signal-candle close minus EMA10, divided by ATR14 of that fully closed 15-minute candle; apply only to new entries and preserve all original opposite-signal exits
catalog.early_exit_definition: After entry, a fully closed 15-minute candle crosses EMA10 against the position; exit at the next available exact next-minute open. Adverse stop gaps and capped target gaps at that open retain precedence. No exit-bar range is read for an open exit.
catalog.cooldown_definition: After a stop or stop gap, block entries for 30 complete clock minutes following the stop minute. Target, timeout, opposite-signal and risk-halt exits do not trigger this additional cooldown.
catalog.selection: Reuse the registered training-only gate from the news-policy catalog; no validation results enter selection. Keep baseline as an unqualified fallback when no variant passes.
catalog.diagnostics: Baseline 2022-2023 trades at base costs only; conservative MFE/MAE bounds exclude unknown intraminute exit-bar ranges, retain known exit endpoints, and cannot change the preregistered variant thresholds.
